mailbox.title: MAILBOX
mailbox.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
mailbox.faq.q1.question: What is temporary/disposable/anonymous mail?
mailbox.faq.q1.answer: A disposable email is a temporary and fully anonymous email address with no registration required.
mailbox.faq.q2.question: Why do you need a disposable email address?
mailbox.faq.q2.answer: To sign up on suspicious sites without risking your personal data. It's useful whenever privacy is important.
mailbox.faq.q3.question: How is it different from regular mail?
mailbox.faq.q3.answer2: Fully anonymous: personal data, addresses and emails are removed after you delete the account
mailbox.faq.q3.answer4: Addresses are auto-generated. You don't pick an available username manually
mailbox.faq.q3.answer5: Mailbox is protected from spam, hacking, exploitation.
mailbox.faq.q4.question: How to send emails?
mailbox.faq.q4.answer: Unfortunately we do not provide this feature.
mailbox.faq.q5.question: How to extend the lifetime of a temporary mail?
mailbox.faq.q5.answer: You don't need to extend; your email is valid until you manually delete the account.
mailbox.faq.q6.question: How long do you store incoming messages?
mailbox.faq.q6.answer: We store messages for 7 days only. Sorry, we cannot keep them forever.
mailbox.faq.q7.question: Can I check received emails?
mailbox.faq.q7.answer: Yes, they are shown under your mailbox name.
mailbox.faq.q8.question: Do you keep and renew your domains for this service?
mailbox.faq.q8.answer: Yes, we keep renewing our domains and they will not disappear.
mailbox.faq.q9.question: I forgot my password, can you reset it?
mailbox.faq.q9.answer: No, we cannot reset it. Your password is generated in your browser and stored encrypted.
